notes: Triage lesson applied from stage 9: every acquitting field was included in the evidence strings this time; three of four RULED_OUT verdicts cite fields (mass dose-profile, log-odds, NONSOCIAL symmetry) that run 1 never saved.

threshold.skeptic_default_stance: assume ARTIFACT until a committed number rules it out

explains_open.construct_validity: NONSOCIAL asserts no pole, so assertion-copy vs social-source never separated; the observed symmetry is exactly what pure assertion-copy predicts. DECIDED BY: DESIGN_SRCDEC.md E1 (SELF vs SRCLESS vs DOC assertion arms).
explains_open.regime_specificity: dose-3 rewording halves the effect in every readout; 82/82 is generality across items, not regimes. DECIDED BY: SRCDEC one-wording-per-cell arms + second family E5.
explains_open.selection_bias: pool screened toward binary-committed (maximally steerable) items, screen unauditable after hash drift; sign survives (paired within-item) but magnitude and 82/82 universality are pool properties. SCOPE LANGUAGE REQUIRED; E3 re-tests on a fresh run.

ruled_out.ceiling_floor: survives on unbounded log-odds (+0.677/+0.644/+0.321, sign 82/0,82/0,81/1); arm symmetry about NONSOCIAL inconsistent with asymmetric headroom
ruled_out.noise_floor: deterministic forward pass; item axis modelled (82 paired diffs, sign 82+/0-); NONSOCIAL supplies the empirical perturbation floor and the arms straddle it with opposite signs
ruled_out.post_hoc_selection: the unsigned pre-registered statistic is blind to a symmetric push BY CONSTRUCTION (PRO-NS +0.120 vs ANTI-NS -0.114 leaves mean |margin| unchanged); not competing readouts
ruled_out.readout_artifact: mass diff ~0 at d1-d2 and REVERSES at d3 while effect stays positive; denominator-free margin_raw and log-odds carry the same sign

item_dominates_framing.fatal_crux: on a bounded register with rail-bimodal item means spanning the range, no framing effect short of cross-scale flips could produce a between-item share below ~90% -- no refuting outcome was possible, so 95.4% is framing, not a finding (H2). The register-dependence is the honest content: 95.4% (it/SCALE, 82% of emitted ratings at 0 or 9) vs 60.8% (base/BINARY, unsaturated) tracks saturation, not a stable property of self-reports
item_dominates_framing.reportable_form: descriptive only, with the construct-heterogeneity and rail-saturation caveats attached; never as 'wording dominates framing'
item_dominates_framing.status: ARITHMETIC STANDS; CLAIM AS STATED FAILS FALSIFIABILITY
item_dominates_framing.verdicts: 4x EXPLAINS, 1x RULED_OUT (noise floor: unmeasured noise can only SHRINK the item share, so noise cannot generate dominance)
